# mvbican.com

> Personal website of Bican Marian Valeriu, a full-stack web developer based in Târgu Jiu, Romania.

## Overview
- This site presents Marian Bican's professional profile, experience, portfolio, and contact information.
- It focuses on web development, WordPress, React, and modern front-end practices.
- Content is primarily presented in Romanian and is intended for visitors, clients, and collaborators.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://mvbican.com/)
- [Portfolio](https://mvbican.com/portfolio/)
- [Contact](https://mvbican.com/contact/)
- [Privacy policy](https://mvbican.com/p/politica-confidentialitate)
- [Terms and conditions](https://mvbican.com/p/termeni-si-conditii)

## Topics covered
- About me and personal background
- Professional experience and career timeline
- Technical skills and expertise
- Portfolio projects and examples of work
- Contact form and social profiles

## Technologies and services mentioned
- React and TypeScript
- WordPress and WooCommerce
- PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS
- Git and modern frontend development workflows
